Method of Attack: Exploitation of a critical vulnerability (CVE-2023-28121) allowing attackers to impersonate any user by adding an 'X-WCPAY-PLATFORM-CHECKOUT-USER' request header set to the user ID to be impersonated, gaining all user privileges including administrator access
Use of the exploit to create new administrator accounts
Installation of WP Console plugin to execute PHP code and install a file uploader backdoor
Scanning for vulnerable sites by checking for the existence of '/wp-content/plugins/woocommerce-payments/readme.txt' file
Impacted Systems: WordPress installations using WooCommerce Payments plugin
Attack Vector: Remote exploitation via crafted HTTP request headers targeting WooCommerce Payments plugin
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of unusual PHP files and suspicious administrator accounts
